blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Extending a text embedding model to new modalities typically degrades text retrieval quality, and existing omni-modal
embedders compensate with multi-billion parameters.
We present Omni-Embed-Mini , a 0.9B-parameter model that maps
text, speech, audio, images, video, and visually-rich documents into
a single shared cosine space without updating any text-side
parameter.
Our key insight is that the teacher signal requires no separate
embedding model: each media sample is paired with a dense cascaded caption,
and the teacher target is simply the frozen backbone’s own embedding
of that caption. Because teacher and student share the same
backbone weights, they inhabit byte-identical geometry, and
lightweight projectors plus phased LoRA adapters on the modality
encoders suffice for alignment.
Training combines a Matryoshka SigLIP contrastive loss with an
online hybrid hard-negative miner whose negatives sharpen as the
encoder improves.
The recipe carries over to a 2.3B variant by swapping in a
native vision-language backbone. Omni-Embed-Mini-0.9B keeps its
text weights bit-identical to the backbone, so training cannot regress text retrieval (49.57 nDCG@10 on MTEB-v2
BEIR-8), while extending it to five additional
modalities, and is ∼ {\sim} 2.7 × \times to 9.5 × \times smaller than
every open omni embedder we compare against. The 2.3B variant is
competitive with the closed gemini-embedding-2, edging ahead of it
on the overall-modality average.
Models, code, data and evaluation harness are on our project page .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A central goal of recent representation learning is a unified embedding space that binds diverse modalities Girdhar et al. (2023) ; Zhu et al. (2024) . In practice,
most attempts to jointly contrastive-train text with vision and audio
face two coupled failure modes.
( i ) Catastrophic forgetting on the text
side McCloskey and Cohen (1989) :
fine-tuning a strong text embedder against media inputs shifts the
text geometry and degrades MTEB performance. Text is still the most critical modality for real-world search, making this degradation highly undesirable. ( ii ) Modality
bloat : existing omni embedders such as LCO-Embedding-Omni-3B/7B Xiao et al. (2026) ,
BidirLM-Omni-2.5B Boizard et al. (2026) , NVIDIA’s
omni-embed-nemotron-3B Xu et al. (2025) , and
e5-omni-3B/7B Chen et al. (2026) have scaled to 2.5 2.5 B to 8.9 8.9 B
parameters in search of enough capacity to absorb every modality,
making them less suited to edge-deployed dynamic retrieval at scale.
We term these two coupled failure modes the multimodal expansion
dilemma : under current recipes, every additional modality forces a trade-off, because mitigating text-side catastrophic forgetting has typically come with much larger models.

blocks.en:
Our contribution is not a new alignment primitive. We combine dense
captioning, frozen-backbone self-distillation, parameter-efficient
modality adaptation, Matryoshka training and online mining into an
omni-modal retrieval recipe with one specific invariant: the deployed
text inference path is unchanged. Concretely:
( i ) Zero-regression omni embedding: a 0.9 0.9 B model (Table 1 ) scores 49.57 nDCG@10 on MTEB-v2 BEIR-8 while adding five modalities; the text branch’s weights are bit-identical to the stock 0.6 0.6 B backbone, so training cannot regress it.
( ii ) Cascaded-caption self-distillation through a shared backbone: teacher and student share weights, so cosine alignment in the native pooled hidden space suffices: no projection head, no separate embedding teacher, fully cacheable targets.
( iii ) Matryoshka SigLIP + online hybrid hard-negative mining + phased LoRA: a parameter-efficient recipe that carries over to a 2.3 2.3 B variant by swapping the backbone for a native vision-language model.
( iv ) To our knowledge, this is the smallest open omni embedder at the time of writing, covering text, speech, audio, image, video, and visually-rich documents in one cosine space.

blocks.en:
ImageBind Girdhar et al. (2023) uses images as a
binding modality: a frozen OpenCLIP ViT-H image encoder serves as anchor,
and per-modality encoders are trained with symmetric InfoNCE to match
the image embedding of naturally co-occurring pairs (image-audio from
video, image-depth from RGB-D, etc.). Cross-modal alignment emerges
because each modality is independently pulled toward the shared image
space. LanguageBind Zhu et al. (2024) adopts the same
anchored-alignment structure but substitutes language for
images as the binding modality, freezing a text encoder and
LoRA-adapting per-modality encoders against it.
AudioCLIP Guzhov et al. (2022) takes a different joint-training
approach, extending CLIP with a three-way contrastive loss across
image, text, and audio.
Omni-Embed-Mini shares LanguageBind’s choice of text as anchor but
departs from both ImageBind and LanguageBind in four ways:
( i ) alignment adds asymmetric distillation (the frozen
backbone embeds a dense caption as the teacher target) to the
contrastive objective, so each modality is also fitted to a fixed
per-sample target vector rather than to batch-level contrast alone;
( ii ) pairing data is manufactured via dense
captioning rather than requiring natural co-occurrence, removing
ImageBind’s reliance on modality-specific paired corpora;
LanguageBind also uses generated captions as contrastive text,
whereas we additionally use them as a distillation target;
( iii ) the text encoder is not a separate frozen tower but the identical backbone that serves both teacher and student, so
both are produced by the same untrained weights and text retrieval
cannot regress;
( iv ) because that backbone is a single causal transformer,
multiple modalities can be interleaved into one token sequence and
encoded in a single pass, rather than each modality passing through
its own tower before a late fusion step. Interleaved multi-modal
queries are therefore native to the architecture rather than an added
capability; we do not isolate their contribution experimentally, and
leave a controlled study to future work.
Conceptually, this is the cross-modal analogue of Reimers and Gurevych (2020) , who aligned a new language to a frozen
English teacher’s sentence space via distillation against translated
sentences; we substitute “language” with “modality” and
“translation” with “dense captioning.” Unlike their separately
trained student, our text tower is frozen outright.

blocks.en:
Two design principles and one training rule govern
Omni-Embed-Mini. (P1) Backbone invariance. The backbone is never updated:
no full fine-tuning, no LoRA on the backbone. This covers the text
path for the 0.9B variant, and the text and vision paths for the
2.3B, which is built on a vision-language backbone. Those paths carry
no projector and their weights are bit-identical to the stock
backbone, so its calibrated retrieval quality is preserved by
construction. (P2) Cascaded-caption self-distillation. Each media sample is paired with a dense caption; the embedding of
that caption, obtained via the same frozen backbone, is the
teacher target. Teacher and student share weights, so a cosine
alignment loss in the native pooled hidden space suffices. (T1) Alignment-first, then adaptation. Phase 1 trains
projectors only; Phase 2 (after 20% of steps) injects encoder LoRA.
The motivation is that, before the projectors have aligned,
encoder LoRA would adapt to noisy upstream projections; we adopt this
schedule as a design choice and do not ablate the switch point.

blocks.en: 3.5 Online hybrid hard-negative mining
blocks.zh: 3.5 (中文(简体) ). 在线混合硬阴性开采

blocks.en:
Hard negatives are supplied by a background subsystem maintaining
FAISS-CPU Johnson et al. (2019) inner-product indices (one for
text, one per media modality), in the
spirit of ANCE Xiong et al. (2020) . A lightweight text cycle ( ∼ \sim 10 × \times /epoch)
re-embeds captions via the text-only path and retains the top- k k neighbours per query. A more compute-intensive media cycle
( ∼ \sim 5 × \times /epoch) re-embeds samples per modality through the
full model into per-modality indices. The miner
shares the live model with the training loop, so each cycle returns
negatives from the current representation: as the encoder
improves, mined negatives become harder. Crucially, because the text
branch never receives gradient, the text-side index is perfectly
stable; only the media-side index drifts, and it is refreshed so as
to supply harder negatives as the encoder improves. This stability is intended to guard against modality collapse without ever destabilising text geometry. Concurrency, cache
semantics, and failure handling are detailed in § D .

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Omni-Embed-Mini , a 0.9B omni-modal retrieval model that binds text, speech, audio, images, video, and visually-rich documents into a unified space by recasting cross-modal alignment as self-distillation through a shared, frozen text backbone. By keeping the text encoder fixed and aligning every other modality to its representation, we sidestep the catastrophic forgetting that typically plagues multi-modal fine-tuning and turn omni-modal training into a lightweight projector-plus-LoRA exercise. The model preserves its backbone’s text retrieval quality while remaining competitive with open omni embedders ∼ {\sim} 2.7 × \times to 9.5 × \times larger, and carries over to a 2.3B variant competitive with baselines 2 × \times to 4 × \times its size. Because the backbone is frozen, future text-embedder improvements can in principle be adopted by re-running only the projector and LoRA training, as our backbone swap from the 0.6B text encoder to Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B illustrates. Open threads include learned mixing of the dual audio-encoder tokens, a Mixture-of-Encoders variant that routes inputs to specialist branches, and replacing per-frame mean-pooling for video (§ I ) with a native spatial pooler that better preserves temporal and spatial structure. Beyond architecture, the most pressing community gap is evaluation: existing benchmarks each probe a single modality slice, and none evaluate cross-modal retrieval in arbitrary query → \to corpus combinations across all six modalities simultaneously.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Omni-Embed-Mini(英语:Omni-Embed-Mini),这是一个0.9B的自制模式检索模型,通过共享的被冻结的文本主干线,将文本,语音,音频,图像,视频和视觉丰富的文档捆绑入一个统一的空间. 通过保持文本编码器的固定,并使所有其他方式都符合其代表性,我们回避了通常困扰多模式微调的灾难性遗忘,将全能模式培训转变为轻量级投影仪-+-LORA演练。 该模型保留了主干线的文本检索质量,同时保持了与开放的自闭式嵌入器的竞争力 ~ ~ ~ sim} 2.7 ×时间到 9.5 ×时间到 9.5 ×时间到 2.3 B 的变体,具有基线 2 ×时间到 4 ×时间到 其大小. 由于主干被冻结,因此未来的文本-嵌入器改进原则上只能通过重新运行投影仪和LORA训练来被采纳,正如我们的骨干交换从0.6B文本编码器到Quen3-VL-Embedding-2B所说明的. 开通线程包括有学识地混合了双相声编码器符号,一种编码器的混合变体将输入引向专家分支,并用一个更能保存时间和空间结构的本地空间集合器来取代视频(§I)的每帧平均集合. 除了结构外,最紧迫的社区差距是评价:现有的基准每个都探测出一个单一模式片段,没有人同时评价所有六种模式的任意查询中的跨模式检索。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Omni-Embed-Mini is a research prototype for omni-modal retrieval and is not validated for high-stakes deployment. Although the model provides efficient alignment across text, speech, audio, image, video, and visually-rich documents, it may still retrieve incorrect, biased, private, or misleading items when used in downstream systems. Therefore, it should not be used as a standalone decision system in sensitive domains without task-specific validation and human oversight.
blocks.zh: Omni-Embed-Mini是全米模式检索的研究原型,没有用于高吸量部署的验证. 虽然该模式在文本、语音、音频、图像、视频和视觉丰富的文件之间提供了高效的对接,但在下游系统使用时仍可能检索不正确、有偏见、私人或误导性的项目。 因此,在没有具体任务验证和人力监督的情况下,不应将其作为敏感领域的独立决策系统。

blocks.en: The model’s shared embedding space is constrained by the frozen text backbone used to preserve text-side retrieval performance. As a result, modality-specific phenomena that are difficult to verbalise, such as complex acoustic textures, abstract visual patterns, or fine-grained temporal cues, may not be fully represented. The cascaded-caption self-distillation pipeline also depends on teacher-generated captions, which may contain hallucinations, omissions, or biases that are inherited by the student model. We do not filter captions for factuality, and we do not verify them against their source media; the only automatic check in the pipeline is a 0.92 cosine threshold used to discard likely false negatives during mining. We also did not run a controlled caption-perturbation study, so we cannot quantify how far retrieval quality degrades as caption quality falls. What we can report is that caption quality matters a great deal in aggregate: replacing our dense cascaded captions with the datasets’ original captions costs 7.01 points on the mean of speech, audio, image and video (Table 2 ) and 4.8 nDCG@10 on visual documents. Because a single captioner produces every target, any systematic bias it carries is applied uniformly across the corpus rather than averaged out, which is the failure mode we would most want to measure. Plausible mitigations we have not implemented include cross-checking captions against a second captioner, filtering on caption-to-media agreement scored by an independent model, and sampling captions for human verification; we regard a caption-robustness study along these lines as the most useful next step for this recipe.
blocks.zh: 该模型的共享嵌入空间受到用于保存文本侧检索性能的被冻结的文本主干线的限制. 因此,难以言语化的模式特定现象,如复杂的相声纹理,抽象的视觉图案,或精细的刻度提示,可能无法被充分体现. 级联封装自沉管道还取决于教师生成的字幕,这些字幕可能包含学生模式所继承的幻觉、遗漏或偏见。 我们不过滤字幕,也不对照其源媒体加以核实;管道中唯一的自动检查是0.92余弦阈值,用于在开采过程中丢弃可能存在的假底片。 我们还没有进行控制标题-扰动研究,因此无法量化检索质量随着标题质量下降而下降的程度。 我们可以报告的是,标题质量在总体上很重要:用数据集原有标题取代我们密集的连锁标题,在语音、音频、图像和视频(表2)和可视文件(4.8 nDCG@10)上花费了7.01分。 由于一个单一的标注器产生每个目标,它携带的任何系统性的偏差都会被统一应用到整个主体中,而不是平均,这是我们最想衡量的失败模式. 我们尚未执行的明显缓解措施包括对照第二个标题对标题进行交叉检查,对独立模型所得出的标题对媒体协议进行过滤,以及取样说明供人类核查;我们认为,按照这些思路进行标题-硬度研究是这一配方最有用的下一步。

blocks.en: The audio pathway currently uses a fixed temporal interleaving of speech and environmental-audio tokens, which may be suboptimal for inputs dominated by only one audio type. In addition, the compact 0.9B and 2.3B model scales are optimised for efficiency, but may limit performance on complex reasoning-heavy multimodal retrieval tasks.
blocks.zh: 音频路径目前使用语音和环境-音频符号的固定时间间隔,对于只有一种音频类型的输入来说,这种间隔可能不够理想。 此外,收缩式0.9B和2.3B模型尺度也优化了效率,但可能会限制复杂的推理重多模式检索任务的性能.

blocks.en: Finally, the evaluation is limited by the coverage of available benchmarks. Existing datasets do not yet provide a unified any-to-any retrieval benchmark across all six supported modalities, so our results may not generalise to all query-corpus combinations, languages, domains, data qualities, or real-world retrieval workflows.
blocks.zh: 最后,评价受到现有基准覆盖面的限制。 现有的数据集尚未在所有六个支持模式中提供统一的任意到任何检索基准,因此我们的结果可能无法概括到所有查询-公司组合、语言、域、数据质量或现实世界的检索工作流程。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work is intended for research and educational use in omni-modal representation learning and retrieval. Omni-Embed-Mini should not be used for autonomous decision-making in high-stakes domains such as medicine, law, finance, hiring, education, security, or public-sector services without appropriate validation and human supervision.
blocks.zh: 这项工作旨在进行研究和教育,用于全面代表性学习和检索。 Omni-Embed-Mini不应在未经适当鉴定和人力监督的情况下,用于在医药、法律、金融、雇用、教育、安全或公共部门服务等高层次领域进行自主决策。

blocks.en: The main ethical risks include inaccurate retrieval, bias amplification, privacy leakage, and misuse. Since the model aligns multiple modalities into a shared embedding space, errors or biases from training data, teacher-generated captions, and pre-trained encoders may affect retrieval quality across languages, accents, visual appearances, environments, document types, and cultural contexts. Downstream users should conduct safety, fairness, privacy, robustness, and human-in-the-loop evaluations before applying the model in sensitive settings.
blocks.zh: 主要道德风险包括检索不准确、偏见放大、隐私被泄露和滥用。 由于该模型将多种模式结合到共享嵌入空间中,培训数据的错误或偏差,教师生成的字幕和预先训练的编码器可能影响跨语言、口音、视觉外观、环境、文件类型和文化背景的检索质量。 下游用户在敏感环境下应用该模式之前,应当进行安全,公平,隐私,稳健,并进行人入室评价.

blocks.en: We also disclose our use of generative AI tools. Writing-support models were used for grammar, style, and clarity improvements. All technical claims, experimental results, analyses, and conclusions were authored, checked, and verified by the authors; any coding assistance was limited to boilerplate scaffolding, minor refactoring, or formatting support.
blocks.zh: 我们还披露了我们使用基因AI工具的情况。 文法、风格和清晰度改进都采用了书写支持模式。 所有技术主张、实验结果、分析和结论均由作者撰写、核对和核实;任何编码协助都仅限于锅炉台脚手架、小重构或格式化支持。

blocks.en: Appendix B Cascaded-caption data generation
blocks.zh: 附录B 封装数据生成

blocks.en:
The caption slice of our omni-modal corpus is the sole training
corpus for the contrastive objective. Every row is the output of a
single multimodal call to Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct at
temperature 0.7 with a 2048-token output budget. The model
receives the raw media plus a modality-specific system prompt that
interpolates the source dataset’s ground-truth caption as a
“Reference caption” grounding prior; a short user-facing prompt is
drawn at random from a per-modality bank and concatenated with the
appropriate media tag.
blocks.zh:
我们的全美模式书的片段是唯一的训练
相对目标。 每行都是一个的输出
向Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct提供单次多式联运呼叫
温度为0.7, 且输出预算为 2048-token。 模型
接收原始介质加特定模式的系统提示
将源数据集的地真字幕插为
“参考标题”在前置下;一个简短的提示是
从每个模式的银行随机抽取,并与
适当的媒体标签。

blocks.en: B.1 Modality system prompts
blocks.zh: B.1 模式系统提示

blocks.en:
System prompt: Audio Describe only what you hear; no opinions, speculation, or filler.
Be precise and factual. Do not hallucinate sounds not present.
Listen to this audio. Reference caption: “ { original_text } ”.
Write a dense, semantically rich description. Cover: each distinct
sound and its characteristics (pitch, volume, texture); temporal
order (what happens first, next, last); acoustic environment
(indoor/outdoor, reverb, background); patterns or repetitions. Be
concise; every word should convey information about the audio. One
paragraph.
blocks.zh:
系统提示 : 音频只描述你听到的;没有意见、猜测或填充器。
准确而实相. 不要产生幻觉 声音不存在。
听此相声. 参考标题:“{正本_正本}”。
写一个密集,精密的描述. 封面:每个不同的
声音及其特征(pitch、音量、纹理);
顺序(先发生,后发生,后发生);音响环境
(室内/室外,回文,背景);图案或重复. 成为
简洁;每个词都应传递音频信息. 一个
页:1

blocks.en:
System prompt: Music (audio music subsets) Describe only what you hear. Listen to this music. Reference
caption: “ { original_text } ”. Write a dense description covering:
instruments and timbres; melody, harmony, key, chord progressions;
rhythm, tempo (BPM estimate), time signature; genre, energy,
dynamics; structure; vocals if present (gender, style, lyrics
gist). One paragraph.
blocks.zh:
系统提示: 音乐( 音频音乐子集) 只描述你听到的 听这音乐 参考文献
标题:“{正文}”。 写一个密集的描述 :
乐器和调子;旋律、和谐、钥匙、和弦;
节奏、节奏(BPM估计),时间标志;流派、能、能、能
动态; 结构; 声音( 性别、 风格、 歌词)
长相. 一一段.

blocks.en:
System prompt: Speech Listen to this speech audio. Write a single flowing paragraph
covering: (1) the speaker (age group, gender, voice pitch/tone,
clarity, accent); (2) speaking style (pace, loudness, emotion);
(3) a transition into the transcription using a casual phrase
followed by the marker [TRANSCRIPTION]; (4) audio quality, recording
environment, background sounds. Use the literal text [TRANSCRIPTION];
do not write out the actual words spoken. The placeholder is
post-processed into a transcription span around the source transcript.
blocks.zh:
系统提示: 语音听此语音音频 。 写一个流出段落
包括:(1) 发言者(年龄组、性别、语音/音调,
清晰度、口音);(2) 说话风格(速度、高音、情绪);
( 三 ) 使用 随便 短语 向 抄录 过渡
之后是标记[TRANSCRITION]; (4)音频质量,录音
环境,背景声音。 使用文字文本[TRANSCRITION];
不要写出真实的话。 占位符为
经处理后,在源记录抄本周围进行记录。

blocks.en:
System prompt: Image Look at this image. Reference caption: “ { original_text } ”. Write
a dense, factual description covering: subjects and objects (what,
how many, attributes); spatial layout and composition; colors,
lighting, and style; any actions or interactions; any text visible
in the image (OCR). Be concrete; avoid speculation about meaning or backstory. One paragraph.
blocks.zh:
系统提示 : 图像看这个图像。 参考标题:“{正本_正本}”。 写入
内容繁多的事实描述,包括:主题和对象(什么,
数量,属性); 空间布局和组成; 颜色,
照明和样式; 任何动作或互动; 任何可见的文本
在图像中(OCR). 具体化;避免对意义或回想的猜测. 一一段.

blocks.en:
System prompt: Visual document You are an expert document analyst. Examine this document image and
provide a comprehensive description covering: document type and
purpose; overall layout and structure; all text content (headings,
body, labels); tables (column headers, row structure, key data);
charts and graphs (type, axes, trends); figures and diagrams; visual
formatting (colors, fonts, emphasis). Be thorough, precise, and well-organised.
blocks.zh:
系统提示 : 视觉文档 你是一个专家的文件分析师。 检查此文档图像和
提供一份涵盖:文件类型和
目的; 总体布局和结构; 所有文本内容(标题
正文、标签); 表格(列标题、行结构、关键数据);
图表(类型、轴、趋势);数字和图表;视觉
格式化(颜色、字体、强调)。 要彻底,准确,组织严密.

blocks.en: B.2 User-prompt banks

blocks.en: C.1 Train/test overlap audit

blocks.en:
Three of our training sources share a parent corpus with MMEB-V2
evaluation tasks, so we ran an identifier-level audit rather than
relying on split names. For each training sample we recovered the
original source identifier and compared it one to one against the
identifiers of the benchmark test samples. The audit finds
zero shared items in all three cases.

blocks.en: Appendix D Mining subsystem
blocks.zh: 附录D 采矿子系统

blocks.en:
The miner runs as a single background thread that shares the live
training model with the main loop, avoiding the roughly 16 GB extra
HBM cost of a separate model copy. Within-cycle weight drift between
miner and main thread is empirically negligible because the LoRA
delta per optimiser step is small and the embedding geometry is
dominated by the frozen backbone.

矿工和主线在经验上可以忽略不计,因为LORA
三角洲/ 每个可选相器步骤很小,嵌入几何是
以被冰冻的骨干为主

blocks.en:
Every modality receives mined hard negatives.
The miner alternates between two cycle types, gated on the training
step counter. A text cycle re-embeds the captions of all five
media modalities, builds a CPU FAISS index, and writes hard-negative
ids into the negative cache; it fires roughly ten times per epoch and
finishes in about thirty seconds. A media cycle re-embeds the
samples of each media modality (speech, audio, image, video and
visual document) through the full model into per-modality indices;
it fires roughly five times per epoch and takes 12 to 20 minutes.
Triggers are coalesced, so multiple firings during a long cycle
collapse to a single follow-up.

媒体模式, 构建 CPU FAISS 索引, 并写硬阴性
IDs into the 负缓存;每个纪元发射大约十次,
大约30秒后完成。 媒体循环重现
每种介质模式的样本(语音、音频、图像、视频和
视觉文件),通过完整的模型进入通式指数;
每个纪元发射大约5次 需要12到20分钟
触发器是连在一起的,所以在长周期内多次起火
崩溃到一个后续。

blocks.en:
A single forward-lock
serialises miner and main-thread forward passes at batch granularity:
the main thread holds the lock for the entire forward, backward and
optimiser step, and the miner acquires it per encode-batch, yielding
fine-grained alternation rather than overlap. The negative cache is
keyed by sample id and overwrites on write, so media-mined entries
supersede earlier text-mined ones for the same sample. If the cache
is empty for a given sample at batch time the collator falls back to
in-batch negatives plus distillation, recovering the no-mining
ablation behaviour with no special-case code.

blocks.en: Appendix E Caption grounding and noise safeguards
blocks.zh: 附录E 说明地基和噪音保障

blocks.en:
Because every teacher target is machine-generated, caption noise is a
direct risk to the learned geometry. Four properties of the recipe
limit how far that noise can propagate. First, the captioner is grounded : the source dataset’s own caption is interpolated
into the prompt, so the model elaborates on a human-written anchor
rather than describing the media unconstrained. Second, the target is
a pooled embedding , not the caption tokens; the student fits a
single vector, so local errors in wording are attenuated by pooling
rather than supervised token by token. Compression is not correction,
however: systematic hallucinations, omissions and semantic biases can
still propagate into the student through the pooled target. Third,
hard-negative mining applies a 0.92 0.92 cosine cutoff, which discards
candidates too close to the anchor to be genuine negatives and so
removes the mining pairs most likely to be caption artefacts. Fourth,
the text path is frozen, so no amount of captioner bias can reach text
retrieval: whatever the captions contain, the text branch is the stock
backbone.

Routing every modality through the same shared backbone and
aligning each one to the caption text places all media in one
geometry after training. We never train a media-to-media objective,
but because every modality shares the text axis as a common
reference frame, pairings such as image ↔ \leftrightarrow audio,
audio ↔ \leftrightarrow video and image ↔ \leftrightarrow document can
in principle be compared directly. This mirrors the emergent
alignment reported by ImageBind Girdhar et al. (2023) , here
induced by a text anchor rather than by contrasting modalities
pair-wise, with the frozen text-embedding backbone supplying the
shared metric.

LLaVA Liu et al. (2023) and most VL models train in two distinct
stages with two distinct datasets. Omni-Embed-Mini runs as a single-stage pipeline: the dataset is loaded once and the

because dense cascaded captions carry both alignment signal and task

blocks.en: Appendix I Additional Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录一 附加限制

blocks.en:
• Vision modes diverge between the 0.9B and 2.3B
variants. The 0.9B variant uses a ViT extracted from the
vision-native Qwen3.5-0.8B model because the 0.6B text backbone has
no vision module; the 2.3B variant
reuses its backbone’s native vision module. The training
configuration accommodates both, but cross-variant ablations of the
two vision strategies are left to future work. • Visual-document captions are roughly six times longer
than other modalities. Visual-document dense captions average about
4,157 characters versus about 582 for audio. The frozen backbone’s
2,048-token context truncates the long tail of visual-document
captions; truncation is consistent between teacher and student paths
so cosine alignment is unaffected, but the upper end of visual-doc
detail is lost from the contrastive signal. • Video uses per-frame mean-pooled embeddings on
MMEB-V2. For all omni-style models, the benchmark’s own 8 frames
per video are embedded as images and mean-pooled. This keeps results
directly comparable but caps video performance below what a native temporal encoder could reach.
